name: SaveSystem
src_typeComment: File-based save/load using Unity's built-in JsonUtility, as an alternative to PlayerPrefs for structured data. For data JsonUtility can't handle (Dictionaries, polymorphic types), use the separate Newtonsoft-based deserializing helper instead — kept as a distinct tool so this one stays dependency-free.

src_members.sig: public static bool Save<T>(string fileName, T data)
src_members.name: Save
src_members.comment: Returns false on failure (disk full, permissions, sandboxed platform I/O restrictions) instead of letting an unhandled exception crash whatever called Save — a lost save shouldn't be a fatal error.

src_members.name: Load
src_members.comment: Returns default(T) if the file doesn't exist yet, or if it exists but fails to read/parse (e.g. a save corrupted by a crash mid-write) — check Exists() first if you need to tell "no save yet" apart from "saved default values", and check the console for a logged error if a load unexpectedly returns default.

src_members.sig: public static bool Exists(string fileName) => File.Exists(GetPath(fileName))
src_members.name: Exists
